blocks.x: Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program
A food processor (dairy) — Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a 13-person team over 11 months, EU scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

Vision grading at intake standardized quality decisions; the yield analytics platform decomposed losses by line and lot; cold-chain telemetry made safety evidence continuous; and the lot-traceability network (Ledger) answers recall queries in minutes with anchored custody events.

The operating cadence, concretely: before any build work, we spend 2 weeks proving the measurement: if two analysts cannot reproduce primary metric the same way, nothing else starts. from week 3 the working slice goes live at portfolio scope: shadow first, then canary, then promoted cohorts — each promotion justified by the eval gate, not enthusiasm. the last 4 weeks convert pilot to product — monitoring, runbooks, enablement sessions, chargeback wiring — and the gate reviews the measured delta, not a demo. Miss a gate and the work pauses — with a written decision, not a quiet scope change. That discipline is why our deltas survive audit.
